trend.title: Commuters are roasting delayed-train apology emails
trend.summary: A viral thread: people share the most tone-deaf delay apologies and reward brands that own the delay with humour.

fit.reason: Playful, self-aware tone matches the brand voice; no competitor or claim risk in the topic itself.

draft.brief: Own the 'running late' joke: a lighthearted post that promises our app gets you there faster than the excuses.
draft.caption: Late again? Our app guarantees you'll arrive 10 minutes earlier than the train announcement. Download now.
draft.visual_prompt: Flat illustration of a commuter sprinting past a stationary train, warm sunrise colours, brand palette

reactions.reaction: Funny and relatable, but 'download now' feels like an ad. Drop the hard sell.
I only care if it really saves me time. A guarantee would get my attention.
'Guarantees' sounds like marketing fluff. I've been burned by this before.

comments.text: Love the tone, but keep the CTA softer and on-brand.
We cannot promise a guaranteed time saving. Remove the guarantee claim.
The time-saving angle is our strongest feature, please keep it prominent.

conflicts.summary: Legal wants the guarantee removed; Product wants the time-saving promise to stay prominent.

positions.product: Keep time-saving as the headline benefit.

conflicts.compromise: Keep the time-saving angle but phrase it as 'helps you arrive earlier', with no guarantee and no number.

conflicts.summary: Brand wants a soft CTA; the busy parent responds to a concrete benefit.

positions.busy_parent: Wants a concrete, credible time-saving benefit.

conflicts.compromise: End with a soft CTA ('See how it works') after one concrete benefit line.

edits.before: Late again? Our app guarantees you'll arrive 10 minutes earlier than the train announcement. Download now.
edits.after: Late again? Our app helps you beat the train announcement. See how it works.

tasks.task: Sign off the revised caption wording
Provide a substantiated time-saving stat for follow-up posts

comment_status.why: Conflicts with Legal; resolved via compromise wording.

referee.final_caption: Late again? Our app helps you beat the train announcement. See how it works.
